section_summary.extract_value: This section reports that participants completed the 5-item Attitudes Toward Unconventional Sex Scale (ATUSS; Fincham & Bradbury, 1987), with items rated 1 to 7 and an overall mean score computed; higher scores indicate greater tendency toward unconventional sexual practices. The section also reports internal consistency for the scale in the present study: Cronbach's α = .91 for both women and men.
section_summary.evidence_source: "Participants completed the 5-item Attitudes Toward Unconventional Sex Scale (ATUSS; Fincham & Bradbury, 1987)... Items were rated on a 7-point scale, ranging from 1 (Strongly disagree) to 7 (Strongly agree), and an overall score was computed as the mean of all items." "In the present study, Cronbach's α for this scale was .91 for both women and men."
